Editable Olmo Python source

Ai2 official source: vendor/olmo-core/src/olmo_core/
Transformer definition: vendor/olmo-core/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/model.py
Official Olmo 3 scripts: vendor/olmo-core/src/scripts/official/OLMo3/
Hugging Face inference definition: vendor/olmo3-transformers/modeling_olmo3.py
Model configuration: vendor/olmo3-transformers/configuration_olmo3.py

The Transformers files are a source excerpt for inspection, not a standalone installed library.
OLMo-core is the full upstream source snapshot, including its own dependency declarations.
No Python dependencies were installed, no model was loaded, and no training was started.
The existing GGUF weights remain unchanged. Source revisions and checksums are recorded in olmo-python-source.json.
Retain each upstream LICENSE and notices when redistributing. The root project license does not replace them.
